assessment.nobel_worthiness: Active matter is a clean case of a simple model revealing a universal mechanism: the Vicsek model shows a nonequilibrium flocking transition, and the Toner-Tu hydrodynamic theory shows that long-range order survives in two dimensions, in violation of Mermin-Wagner, with anomalous scaling exponents. It founded a field spanning bird flocks, bacterial suspensions and synthetic colloids, and it uses the statistical-physics tools I trust (renormalization group, hydrodynamics, symmetry).
assessment.attribution: Vicsek (numerical model, 1995), Toner and Tu (continuum theory and RG exponents, 1995 and 1998) and Ramaswamy (hydrodynamics of active suspensions, Simha-Ramaswamy 2002) form a natural triple of distinct, decisive contributions. Credit of the continuum theory to Toner versus Tu is a possible concern, but Tu is not in the supplied credited names, so the three listed names are the available configuration.
assessment.maturity: Three decades of theory and many experiments (vibrated granular layers, motility assays, Janus colloids, bacterial turbulence) support the picture. Quantitative tests of the Toner-Tu exponents are still partial and the field is still evolving, but the foundational ideas are stable and widely understood.
uncertainties: Precise experimental confirmation of the Toner-Tu exponents is limited, and the frontier remains broad and loosely defined.
The Nobel Committee for Physics may see active matter as less established than other fields, and the best three-person split of credit is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Kardar-Parisi-Zhang equation defines a universality class for nonequilibrium growth, with exponents and exact scaling distributions (Tracy-Widom statistics) linked to random-matrix theory. It is a paradigm of the type of result I value: a minimal stochastic model with exactly solvable universal fluctuations that appear in surprisingly diverse systems.
assessment.attribution: The 1986 KPZ paper was by Kardar, Parisi and Zhang. Parisi is not in the supplied names and is already a laureate (2021), and I cannot assess whether that influences the committee. Of the supplied names, Kardar and Zhang are the inventors of the equation. Spohn's mathematically exact results on the KPZ class (with Prähofer) are important for the later universality picture but are a distinct, later contribution.
assessment.maturity: Strong confirmation: the turbulent liquid-crystal experiments (Takeuchi and Sano), the exact solutions, and recent observations in quantum spin chains and cold atoms. The class is now well understood, which makes recognition timely, if somewhat late.
uncertainties: The supplied credit excludes Parisi (already a laureate) and omits other key contributors to the exact solutions, such as Johansson, Sasamoto, Spohn's collaborators, and Amir, Corwin, Quastel, so the allocation is open.
Whether the committee regards KPZ as a theoretical landmark with enough experimental grounding is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The prediction of the quantum spin Hall effect and the Z2 topological classification of time-reversal-invariant insulators, followed by observation in HgTe quantum wells, opened the field of topological band matter. It is a fundamental conceptual advance with a clean theory and a decisive experiment, and it influenced materials science, spintronics and quantum devices.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele (Z2 invariant and quantum spin Hall, 2005) are the theoretical originators. Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang's HgTe proposal and Molenkamp's experimental confirmation (2007) follow closely; Zhang is not in the credited names, which leaves the credit imperfect. Molenkamp is a plausible experimental laureate. Other claimants (Fu, Moore, Balents; Hasan, Cava on 3D materials) are not in the list.
assessment.maturity: Extremely well confirmed through ARPES, transport and many material families. The 2016 prize recognized topological phase transitions and Thouless-Haldane-Kosterlitz, so timing is plausible but there may be a perceived overlap.
uncertainties: The overlap with the 2016 prize and the exclusion of Zhang, Fu, Moore, Hasan and others complicates a fair three-person configuration.
The quantum spin Hall experiments reached limited precision of quantization compared with the quantum Hall effect.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model predicted flat bands at a magic twist angle, and the experimental discovery of correlated insulators and superconductivity in magic-angle graphene created the field of moire quantum matter. This is a rare example in which a simple continuum model predicts a surprising phenomenon, and experiment confirms it, with a broad and ongoing influence on condensed matter.
assessment.attribution: Bistritzer and MacDonald made the 2011 theoretical prediction; Jarillo-Herrero's group (Cao et al., 2018) made the experimental discovery. Pablo Jarillo-Herrero and MacDonald is a natural pair; Bistritzer is a possible third name, but a prize configuration of the two senior figures may be more consistent with prior practice. Other contributors (Santos and Peres, Lopes dos Santos, Dean, Young, Yacoby) are not in the credited list.
assessment.maturity: Replicated by many groups in transport and by scanning probes; mechanisms for the superconductivity are still debated. The field is young, so the recognition may be premature relative to full understanding.
uncertainties: The pairing mechanism of twisted-bilayer-graphene superconductivity is unresolved, so the physical understanding is incomplete.
Credit for the earlier theoretical antecedents is shared with people not listed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Aharonov-Bohm effect and Berry's geometric phase show that gauge potentials and geometry carry physical meaning in quantum mechanics, which later underlies the theory of polarization, the quantum Hall effect, topological band theory and adiabatic transport. They are foundational papers that contain very general ideas, in the sense that I appreciate.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov and Bohm (1959) discovered the effect; Bohm is deceased and not in the supplied names, and Berry (1984) identified the geometric phase for adiabatic cycles, with prior Pancharatnam work. Aharonov and Berry are the two supplied names, which makes a two-person prize possible, though the two discoveries are distinct and the combination is somewhat artificial.
assessment.maturity: Both effects have been verified extensively (Chambers, Tonomura, many interferometric and optical experiments). The delayed recognition raises the question of timeliness, but the legacy is mature.
uncertainties: The pairing of two separate discoveries as one prize topic is conceptually awkward, and Bohm is excluded by death.
Precedence issues (Ehrenberg-Siday for AB, Pancharatnam for geometric phase) require careful treatment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Car-Parrinello unified scheme joins density-functional electronic structure with molecular dynamics, enabling ab initio simulation of liquids, solids and chemical reactions. Its influence in physics, chemistry and materials science is vast and its methodological originality is clear.
assessment.attribution: The 1985 paper by Car and Parrinello is an unambiguous two-person contribution; both credited names are the decisive originators.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of widespread use make its impact clear. A computational method has Nobel precedent (the 2013 chemistry prize for multiscale models and 1998 for density-functional theory), and so physics may defer to chemistry for this topic.
uncertainties: The prize may be seen as chemistry rather than physics, and the Physics committee might consider it outside its remit.
Whether the method is a physical discovery or a computational invention in the sense of Nobel's will is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The optical lattice clock, based on Katori's magic-wavelength proposal and realized with strontium, reaches fractional uncertainties near 1e-18 and supports tests of fundamental physics, relativistic geodesy and a redefinition of the second. It is a significant measurement advance, with clean conceptual origin.
assessment.attribution: Katori's 2001-2003 magic-wavelength idea and first clocks, and Ye's subsequent record-precision developments, form a plausible two-person prize. Ye worked with Hall (2005 laureate) and is a leading later contributor to record precision, and other groups (Lemonde, Ludlow, Schmidt, Hinkley and others) are not listed.
assessment.maturity: Mature and independently validated at multiple institutes, with ongoing progress. Recognition is timely given the discussion about redefining the second.
uncertainties: The ion-clock contributions (Wineland, Rosenband, Schmidt) and the Hall-Hänsch prize may overlap in the committee's mind.
Whether a metrology advance has the conceptual originality of a new discovery is a matter of the committee's taste.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The jamming picture explains the onset of rigidity in disordered packings as a critical point with isostatic scaling, connecting glasses, foams, granular matter and also learning in neural networks. It is the sort of simple and general mechanism that I value, with sharp theoretical predictions and numerical tests.
assessment.attribution: Liu and Nagel proposed the jamming phase diagram (1998) and O'Hern, Silbert, Liu and Nagel provided key numerics; Wyart contributed the isostatic and marginal-stability theory. O'Hern and Silbert are not in the credited names and the mean-field theory work of Parisi and Zamponi overlaps with these ideas, so credit allocation is not clean.
assessment.maturity: Broad numerical and some experimental support (granular, colloidal, emulsions), but the connection to real glass transitions and the critical exponents' universality in finite dimensions is still debated, which makes recognition potentially premature.
uncertainties: The critical nature and upper critical dimension of jamming remain debated, and the extent of experimental validation is uncertain.
Overlap with replica mean-field theory (Parisi, already recognized) complicates the allocation.
